scope: CE-11b unit U3 remainder and unit U4, first part (track u4). U3 remainder: the effect bounds of every ideal command including the allocator's no-room branch (PqxdhDeploymentIdealEnvCost), frame_ideal, frame_idealD, c4_ideal, c4_ideal_later and F4 on the final split game's own support (PqxdhDeploymentIdealFrame). U4 first part: the transcript functions of design-v2 section 7.1 and U6's key facts on the record world (PqxdhDeploymentIdealTrace), the provenance-annotated record world tools and the World annotation invariant (PqxdhDeploymentIdealOrigins), the session and token facts (PqxdhDeploymentIdealSessions), the provenance invariant Prov with origins_ghost, L1 and L3 (ideal_trace_world, ideal_trace) and three of the four conjuncts of IdealSlots (ideal_slots_server) (PqxdhDeploymentIdealProvenance). Review fix pass (review of 9c477e45): PqxdhDeploymentIdealAnomaly (ctGuessBy, the ciphertext guess of an explicit guesser program, with ctGuessBy_le <= ctGuessPk, ctGuessBy_le_ctGuess, ctGuessPk_eq_iSup, ctGuessBy_probComp, ambientLift, guess_preChallenge) and three premise-free corollaries in PqxdhDeploymentIdealProvenance (ideal_trace_world_peer, ideal_trace_peer, ideal_slots_restrictions); docstrings; no existing statement changed. Not built: the Beacon converse (L4) and the full ideal_slots, ideal_slots_prefix, L2, anomaly_le and its public-key-only form anomaly_le_pk (ctGuessBy at an explicit guesser). Reviewed at 9c477e45; the fix pass is not reviewed; not integrated.
